tools.name: export_video
tools.description: Export the current saved timeline only when the user asks for a video. Uses the same persistent export queue and Press/Export view as the editor. Saves a managed MP4 and returns an authenticated download link; no server folder paths. Requires the current project_read revision; never silently export another revision. Quality, codec, frame rate, size, bitrate, target loudness, motion blur and subtitles use the editor's existing export pipeline. range marks/selection refers to the range when the user sent this message. Repeating identical arguments in one turn reuses its job. Reuse job to wait; do not restart failed/cancelled jobs unless the user requests retry:true. Maximum three new exports per turn. Stopping the turn cancels its active exports, not manual jobs. A timed-out wait leaves the export running in Press/Export.

tools.name: export_status
tools.description: Read current export progress, saved revision, errors and completed video/subtitle download links from the editor's shared export queue. No job lists recent jobs in this project. Does not start or retry an export.

tools.name: export_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a specific export in this project when requested. Uses the same Cancel control as the export UI and does not delete completed output. Read-only mode cannot cancel; Ask mode confirms. Read export_status to identify the correct job first.
